original_metadata.title: Quadratic criterion for involutivity of an endovolutive real or complex tableau in generic bases with its Cartan-character block constraints
original_metadata.author: Abraham D. Smith
original_metadata.source_title: Constructing Involutive Tableaux with Guillemin Normal Form
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The proof converts Cartan dimension equality for the prolonged tableau into explicit quadratic relations among its symbol blocks. A two-index induction eliminates nested prolongation coefficients and pairs all residual higher products, establishing necessity and sufficiency in arbitrary tableau dimension rather than checking only small matrix examples.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Theorem3.2 author proof and all Section2 normal-form definitions read. A is assumed endovolutive in the specified generic bases, with B_i^lambda supported in the top-left s_lambda block; the theorem is not a criterion for arbitrary non-endovolutive presentations. The required equations are (B_i^lambda B_j^mu-B_j^lambda B_i^mu)^a_b=0 for lambda<i<j,lambda<=mu<j,a>s_i and every b. The author carries the nested-indices expansion through the general inductive cancellation, with explicit small-dimensional examples supporting the pattern. Prior existence of an endovolutive basis for involutive tableaux is not needed to expand the selected domain. No Guillemin or Cartan-Kahler corollary is counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem3.2 for finite-dimensional real or complex W,V and an endovolutive tableau A subset W tensor V-star expressed in generic bases as(2.1), with Cartan characters s_i and the paper identity-augmented block maps B_i^lambda. Involutivity iff the exact stated quadratic block projections vanish; its final commuting-on-Y consequence belongs to this same theorem, not another count.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The complete original Theorem 3.2 and its full arbitrary-dimensional double-index induction are retained with all generic-basis, Cartan-character, identity-augmented symbol-block and endovolutive-tableau definitions. The exact quadratic criterion and its concluding commuting-on-Y consequence form one main problem unit. Every small-dimensional preparatory calculation and the entire higher-product cancellation and Cartan-test closure are supplied as uncounted proof core. The domain remains endovolutive tableaux in the specified generic bases; the previously known existence lemma is background and does not enlarge this domain. All original TikZ diagrams remain editable. No later Guillemin, rank-one or Cartan-Kahler corollary is selected.
